correctness.rationale: All q>=1: reducing to first/last occurrences preserves singleton and pair observations; diagonal aa forces at least two copies. Pair presence is exactly absence of the reverse nonoverlap relation. Every (2+2)-free poset has nested predecessor sets, from which explicit endpoints 2i(x), 2j(x)-1 realize the poset and a twice-occurring word. Inclusion anti-isomorphism follows by complement of reversed order relations. Program independently verifies BFS minimal signature depth and direct word endpoint enumeration for q<=5. No unproved extrapolation.

value.rationale: The exact all-alphabet identification of the hardest (maximal shortest representative) layer of Simon level-two congruence with labeled interval orders answers a well-motivated structural slice of finite-index formal-language classification. The bijection imports established exact labelled/unlabelled counts and sharp asymptotics and identifies the pair-observation inclusion order; it is mathematically substantive beyond tabulating small cases or restating established interval-order enumeration. Does not claim a full solution to the index problem.
